title: TIMELORD KEY NEEDS A HOLD
why: His 10-31 report: brushing the key left of 1 switches timelord mode on and saves it. Watch: timelord mode needs a held key and is off limits in the demo.
now: A tap does nothing. Hold the key left of 1 for 0.6 seconds to switch timelord mode once. The demo ignores the shortcut; Shift still opens tuning. LOCAL: no linked review.
